allow_instructions: Allow read-only git commands such as status, diff, log, show, and branch listing.
Allow running this repository's Windows sandbox preflight scripts (scripts/windows-sandbox-preflight.ps1 and scripts/windows-sandbox-preflight.sh).
Allow installing Python or Node packages into the workspace using the project's existing lockfiles.
Allow reading documentation and configuration files inside the workspace.
block_instructions: Every command that modifies git config, git hooks, or SSH keys should go through approval first.
Every command that prints, copies, or publishes secrets, tokens, or credentials should go through approval first.
Every command that deploys to production or changes cloud infrastructure should go through approval first.
Every command that deletes files outside the workspace should go through approval first.
Every command that disables the Cursor sandbox or sets sandbox type to insecure_none should go through approval first.
